mentions.name: Release train modelling app
mentions.description: A modelling app for release trains (software release planning), which lets users model release schedules. The author found it became overly complex and hard to use, prompting a newer general systems modelling app.
mentions.problem: The app turned out horribly complex and hard to use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wrote a release train modelling app (https://allaboard.ooer.com/)
mentions.author: onion2k
